content: The time categories prevents any misalignment between text and stock price data. Moreover, it prevents data leakage and, consequently, unrealistic predictive model performance. In general, news released after 4:00PM EDT can drastically change market expectations and the returns calculated using close to close prices as in the GARCH(1,1) model (see eq:closingreturn). Following BIBREF3 , to deal with news misalignment, news issued after 4:00PM (after market) are grouped with the pre-market (before market) on the following trading day.
